scope: Pinned sphere URDF; Q30 rotations, Q24 internal positions and angles, Q13 output; no physical model uncertainty
notes: Coverage uses the retained input-point AABB per voxel, not an assertion that arbitrary unsampled solid geometry is occupied.
A radius is rounded upward. Self-collision inflates both sphere radii.
Adaptive edge intervals are certified at their midpoint with 2m reach times half the joint variation plus one Q13 unit; uncertified intervals are subdivided or rejected.
